stages.name: Governance and intake
stages.responsibility: Bound authority, context, data governance, and routing before substantive work.

stages.name: Discovery and research
stages.responsibility: Collect and validate user, market, system, and operational evidence.

stages.name: Strategy and prioritization
stages.responsibility: Choose evidence-backed direction while preserving human decision authority.

stages.name: Requirements and planning
stages.responsibility: Produce traceable requirements, specifications, plans, and handoffs.

stages.name: Experience design
stages.responsibility: Design flows, visual systems, interaction states, accessibility, and prototypes.

stages.name: Architecture, risk, and security
stages.responsibility: Define technical boundaries, data/API/security contracts, risks, and operational assumptions.

stages.name: Implementation and integration
stages.responsibility: Implement, integrate, debug, and self-check bounded source changes.

stages.name: Verification and quality
stages.responsibility: Run independent review, tests, QA, regression, and evidence gates.

stages.name: Performance and reliability
stages.responsibility: Measure and improve performance, resilience, and deployment readiness.

stages.name: Release readiness
stages.responsibility: Package and preflight a release without executing remote change.

stages.name: Deployment change
stages.responsibility: Execute explicitly authorized remote deployment or configuration change.

stages.name: Observation and canary
stages.responsibility: Observe production behavior, alerts, canaries, and post-deploy health.

stages.name: Incident and recovery
stages.responsibility: Investigate production failures, coordinate incidents, and execute rollback or recovery.

stages.name: Learning and feedback
stages.responsibility: Capture outcomes, retrospectives, decisions, and feedback for a new pass.

stages.name: Tool runtime support
stages.responsibility: Provide cross-cutting local runtime and artifact support; not a lifecycle approval step.
